blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.title: Senior Editor, Research & Intelligence
blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.description: About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Editor, Research & Intelligence to help us understand what our audience actually cares about and turn that into content, products, and measurable audience growth. This role sits at the center of our audience and editorial strategy. Your job is to gather real-world input from interviews, surveys, events, strategic partners, and market activity, and turn it into clear insights that shape what we publish, what we build, and how we grow our subscriber base. This is not a traditional editing role. It is about identifying patterns, making sense of information, and helping the organization make better decisions based on real audience needs. Your work will directly improve content quality, increase conversion, and drive audience growth.
responsibilities: 1. Build a clear understanding of our audience: You will lead how we gather insight about senior decision-makers across our brands.
Run surveys and research to capture first-party data
Conduct and synthesize editorial interviews and expert conversations
Pull insights from events, community discussions, and market activity
Gather and synthesize insights from strategic partners and external collaborators
Identify patterns in what our audience cares about, struggles with, and prioritizes
Your goal is to build a consistent, reliable view of what matters most to our audience.
2. Turn inputs into clear, usable insights:  You will take what we learn and turn it into direction.
Translate research and observations into clear insights tied to decisions
Bring together internal data and partner insights into a single point of view
Connect insights directly to recommended actions and expected outcomes
Translate insights into clear reports and briefings that leadership and teams can act on
Inform editorial direction, content strategy, and audience targeting
Ensure major initiatives are grounded in real audience understanding
Your work should answer: What does this mean, and what should we do differently because of it?
3. Lead insight-driven content and research: You will create the outputs that demonstrate our authority and drive audience growth.
Develop reports, surveys, and insight-driven content
Partner with strategic partners on co-created research and intelligence projects
Support experiences designed to convert readers into subscribers, including interactive tools and insight-driven email content
Package findings into formats that attract and convert subscribers
Ensure insight-driven content and research directly contribute to subscriber growth
Partner with revenue, sponsorship, and events teams to ensure this work supports commercial opportunities
These outputs should drive credibility, subscriber growth, and measurable performance.
4. Measure performance and make recommendations that drive audience growth: You will own how insight-driven work is evaluated and improved, with a clear focus on driving audience growth.
Define how we measure the performance of insight-driven content and experiences
Track and analyze performance to understand what is driving subscriber growth and what is not
Make clear, actionable recommendations tied directly to audience growth
Deliver clear, actionable reports to leadership and teams that inform decisions and next steps
Partner with editorial, audience, and product teams to apply those recommendations
Use insights from partners to inform what we prioritize, measure, and scale
Your work should lead to continuous improvement and measurable audience growth.
5. Build a repeatable system for insight:  You will create a system, not one-off projects.
Establish a consistent pipeline from input to insight to output
Incorporate partner-driven insights into ongoing workflows
Create repeatable ways to gather, analyze, and apply insights
Ensure we are continuously learning and improving
Help the company stay ahead of audience needs and market shifts
The goal is to make insight part of how we operate every day.
qualifications: Experience working with research, insights, or audience data in a way that influenced decisions
Strong interviewing and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn conversations and data into clear insights
Ability to connect qualitative inputs and performance data to recommendations and next steps
Experience creating content, reports, or products based on research or insights
Experience designing and running surveys or structured research projects
Experience turning research or insights into subscriber growth or audience-facing products
Experience working with external partners to gather insights or develop joint initiatives
Comfort working across editorial, audience, product, and partnerships
Strong judgment and clarity in how you communicate findings

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d900e1a-b5c8-.title: Financial Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d900e1a-b5c8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Financial Analyst based in the United States. As a Financial Analyst, you will examine financial data and turn it into clear insights that support business decisions and financial planning. You will play an important role across the full order-to-cash cycle, with particular focus on accounts receivable, collections, and revenue recognition. The position combines financial analysis, accounting, reporting, and business partnership in a detail-oriented environment. You will contribute to month-end and quarter-end close activities while preparing accurate reports and reconciliations for senior leadership. You will also support audits, financial reviews, special projects, and ad hoc analysis as business needs evolve. Strong analytical thinking, financial modeling, and communication skills will enable you to make a meaningful impact. This is an opportunity to develop your finance career while working closely with stakeholders across the organization. Build strong relationships with business units and provide responsive, high-quality financial support and customer service. Support month-end and quarter-end close processes by analyzing financial results, preparing journal entries, and completing detailed balance sheet reconciliations. Prepare financial reporting and insights for senior management, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and actionable. Monitor and analyze deferred maintenance, hardware, software, and revenue streams to support accurate financial reporting. Support accounts receivable, collections, and order-to-cash activities while contributing to accurate revenue recognition in accordance with IFRS 15. Prepare documentation and respond to information requests during quarterly financial reviews and annual audits. Develop financial models and perform analysis to support financial planning, decision-making, and business performance evaluation. Contribute to special projects, ad hoc reporting, and other analytical initiatives as required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Previous experience in financial analysis, accounting, or a closely related discipline. Completion of, or active progress toward, a professional accounting designation such as CPA. Strong financial modeling capabilities and confidence working with financial data and reporting. Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify trends and translate financial information into useful insights. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both financial and non-financial stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively both independently and collaboratively. Familiarity with revenue recognition principles, accounts receivable, financial close processes, and IFRS 15 is highly valuable. Benefits: Competitive annual salary ranging from $50,000 to $55,000 . Full-time employment with opportunities for professional and career development. Comprehensive employee benefits package. Opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your financial expertise. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Opportunity to contribute to meaningful financial analysis and business initiatives. Inclusive workplace committed to equal employment opportunities and accessibility. Potential flexibility through remote work arrangements, depending on location and role requirements. jobgether-jobgether:lever:3077ec83-965d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Systemic Justice roster based in Netherlands. This is an opportunity to join a growing network of professionals contributing to racial, social, and economic justice through strategic litigation. The roster welcomes people with diverse backgrounds, disciplines, and areas of expertise, from community organising and facilitation to legal, academic, creative, financial, and project management roles. You may be considered for future employment, consultancy, or volunteer opportunities as relevant needs emerge. The work is remote and collaborative, with a strong focus on community-centred approaches to systemic change. You’ll contribute to an organisation grounded in anti-oppression, intersectionality, and justice. It is an opportunity to bring your expertise and perspective to work designed to challenge structural inequalities and broaden access to justice. Contribute professional expertise to initiatives supporting racial, social, and economic justice through strategic litigation and related activities. Bring specialist knowledge or practical skills that may support future organisational, legal, advocacy, campaigning, operational, creative, or community-focused projects. Collaborate with colleagues and partner organisations to centre affected communities and strengthen access to judicial remedies. Support work aimed at addressing and dismantling structural inequalities and the power structures that reinforce injustice. Participate in consultancy, volunteer, or future employment opportunities depending on organisational needs and your areas of expertise. Contribute to a remote, collaborative working environment grounded in anti-oppression, intersectionality, and justice. Apply your professional perspective and lived experience thoughtfully to help advance community-led systemic change. Requirements: Relevant professional, academic, community, creative, legal, operational, or other specialist experience that could contribute to work focused on racial, social, and economic justice. The roster welcomes a broad range of profiles, including community organisers, facilitators, visual artists, academics, project managers, legal professionals, finance specialists, and other professionals with relevant expertise. Strong written and spoken English, as English is the primary working language. Ability to work effectively in a remote and collaborative environment. Alignment with values of anti-oppression, intersectionality, equality, and justice. Thoughtfulness about power, privilege, and systems of oppression, including reflection on how your own lived experience may relate to this work. Location within or close to the CET time zone is an advantage, with the wider working window extending approximately two hours on either side. A proactive, collaborative, and community-centred approach to contributing expertise and supporting systemic change. Benefits: Access to potential future employment opportunities aligned with your profile and organisational needs. Potential consultancy opportunities across relevant projects and areas of expertise. Opportunities to contribute on a volunteer basis. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to work with an international, multidisciplinary network focused on racial, social, and economic justice. Ability to contribute expertise to community-centred strategic litigation and broader systemic change initiatives. Opportunity to work within an organisation guided by anti-oppression, intersectionality, and justice. Roster registration remains active for consideration for relevant opportunities for up to two years. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8951bd38-e699-.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8951bd38-e699-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in Spain. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. Your work will directly support capabilities ranging from process monitoring to emerging AI-driven automation experiences. You’ll tackle complex challenges around data storage, retention, streaming, secondary storage, and scalability. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a sophisticated backend platform while growing your expertise in data-intensive systems. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as platform usage grows, while developing tooling that supports observability, troubleshooting, and safe production operations. Investigate and resolve complex data-layer production issues, including slow queries, indexing problems, and execution-plan challenges, as part of L3 support and on-call rotations. Partner with Product Management, Support, SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure technical solutions meet customer needs and production requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Hands-on experience with at least one major database or search technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Practical understanding of query performance, indexing strategies, data modeling, execution plans, and the trade-offs involved in designing data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, task decomposition, implementation, and reliable delivery. Ability to troubleshoot data-related production issues and investigate slow queries, index usage, and other performance bottlenecks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment, with the ability to work effectively with Product and engineering stakeholders and provide and receive constructive code-review feedback. Willingness to use and understand the product as part of developing customer-focused solutions. Experience with workflow automation, process orchestration, or developer platforms is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Familiarity with CI pipelines and database migration or schema-evolution tools such as Liquibase or Flyway is beneficial. Benefits: Competitive, transparent, location-based compensation, with the applicable range determined by skills, experience, and location. Our partner is looking for a Engineering Manager, Identification Accuracy based in Saudi Arabia. This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of machine learning, data science, and fraud prevention. You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for improving the accuracy and reliability of a critical identification platform. The role combines people leadership, technical strategy, and hands-on program direction in a globally distributed, fully remote environment. You’ll shape the team roadmap and guide the development of production ML systems operating at massive scale. Working closely with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams, you’ll translate business needs into meaningful technical priorities. This is an opportunity to influence both the technology and the people behind a best-in-class fraud detection capability. Lead and grow a multidisciplinary Identification Accuracy team spanning ML engineers, data scientists, analysts, and analytics engineers, fostering psychological safety, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Own the team’s technical roadmap in collaboration with senior engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, identifying opportunities to improve model quality and address complex identification challenges. Drive measurable model accuracy outcomes by enabling the team to design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that improve identification performance across billions of devices. Oversee the delivery of production ML systems across data pipelines, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability. Partner closely with platform and API engineering teams to understand downstream requirements, performance expectations, and latency constraints. Collaborate with Product and customer-facing teams to translate customer needs and business priorities into technical initiatives and product improvements. Communicate model performance, data-quality considerations, technical trade-offs, risks, and roadmap priorities clearly to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders. Continuously improve engineering and ML practices, including experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data workflows, and operational processes. Strong technical understanding of machine learning and data systems, with familiarity with MLOps practices and tooling such as experiment tracking, feature stores, model registries, and ML CI/CD pipelines. Ability to work effectively with platform and API engineering teams and understand technical requirements, system dependencies, and latency constraints. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8e95f60-eb19-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Colombia. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS.
